indications.name: Adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic ROS1-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who received a prior ROS1 kinase inhibitor
indications.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-11-20: Confirmed by the ORIG-1 approval letter; the original label (ORIG-1) lists it.

evidence.quote: This NDA provides for the use of Jideytro (zidesamtinib) tablets for the treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic ROS 1-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who received a prior ROS1 kinase inhibitor.

pivotal.indication: Adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic ROS1-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who received a prior ROS1 kinase inhibitor
